title: S 级核心词 · 第 29 组
objectives: 认识并会读这 40 个高频词：点 🔊 音标听发音，跟读一遍
记住每个词的**中文意思**和**英文释义**，并用近义词、反义词把意思连成一片
在例句短文里认出这些词，体会它们在句子里的语气（褒、贬、中性）

items.zh: 单调的，乏味的，一成不变的，无变化的
items.en: dull because of lack of variety

items.zh: 侮辱性的言辞，辱骂，谩骂，痛骂，（尖锐的）抨击
items.en: harsh, abusive language

items.zh: 实用主义的，务实的，讲究实效的，注重实际的，（学派）实用的
items.en: dealing with things sensibly and practically

items.zh: 解放，解除束缚，使获得自由，使摆脱（约束）
items.en: to free from restraint or control

items.zh: 挥霍的，奢侈的，过度的，不必要的，（言论、行为）过分的，浪费的
items.en: spending or doing more than is reasonable

blocks.text: The [[monotonous]] speech was full of [[invective]]; a [[pragmatic]] leader sought to [[emancipate]] the staff from [[extravagant]] rules.

items.zh: adj. 闲置的，未使用的，懒散的，无所事事的，无用的，无根据的；vi. 懒散度日，（引擎）空转
items.en: not working or in use; lazy

items.zh: adj. 不重要的，微小的，轻微的，纤细的；vt. 轻蔑，看不起，忽略，疏忽，冷落；n. 轻视，怠慢
items.en: small in degree; to treat as unimportant

items.zh: 巨大的，惊人的，了不起的，非凡的，奇异的
items.en: remarkably great in size or amount

items.zh: 不懈的，不知疲倦的，持续不衰的，坚持不懈的
items.en: not growing weak or tired

items.zh: 狡猾的，不坦率的，不正直的，曲折的，迂回的
items.en: sly and indirect in methods

blocks.text: The [[idle]] heir viewed a [[slight]] as the start of a [[prodigious]] feud; his [[unflagging]] rival was [[devious]].

items.zh: 先驱者，先导，前身，前兆，预兆
items.en: something that comes before and leads to another

items.zh: 确信无疑，确定，确实，确凿
items.en: complete certainty

items.zh: 沉默寡言的，话少的，不爱说话的，缄默的
items.en: habitually silent and reserved

items.zh: 敌意，憎恨，（尤指无理的）强烈敌意，动机，意图
items.en: strong hostility or ill will

items.zh: vt. 羞辱，使丧失名誉，怀疑，不相信，使不可信，使名誉扫地；n. 丧失名誉，不信任，耻辱
items.en: to harm the reputation of; to cause to be doubted

blocks.text: The [[precursor]] of the new faith spoke with [[certitude]]; critics could [[discredit]] him, and the [[taciturn]] monk bore an [[animus]] against the court.

items.zh: 责难，抨击，对…提出质疑，指责，非难
items.en: to challenge the truth or honesty of

items.zh: 易驾驭的，温顺的，易处理的，易管教的，（金属）易加工的
items.en: easy to control or persuade

items.zh: vt. 束缚，限制，阻碍，给…戴上镣铐；n. （常用复数）镣铐，桎梏，束缚
items.en: to restrain or limit; a chain on the limbs

items.zh: vt. 绕行，避开，（沿着）…的边缘，回避（问题等）；n. 裙子，边缘
items.en: to go around; to avoid dealing with

items.zh: 固执的，不可动摇的，坚定的，坚决的（常用 adamant about/that）
items.en: refusing to change one's mind

blocks.text: The [[adamant]] critic would [[impugn]] his motives; the [[tractable]] clerks would not [[shackle]] him, and he knew how to [[skirt]] the law.

items.zh: 显示相似，把…比作，把…比喻为，将…比作（to）
items.en: to point out the similarity between

items.zh: 顺从的，服从的，（符合规范要求）遵守的，依从的，易于接受的
items.en: ready to obey or agree

items.zh: 善变的，多变的，多才多艺的，千变万化的，变化多端的
items.en: able to change shape or role often

items.zh: （通过让步以）平息，抚慰，安抚，使息怒，使和解
items.en: to calm someone by giving in a little

items.zh: 阻挠，使受挫，挫败，反对，使落空
items.en: to prevent from succeeding

blocks.text: The mayor would [[liken]] the [[compliant]] council to sheep; a [[protean]] aide tried to [[placate]] him, but could not [[thwart]] the vote.

items.zh: 痛恨，厌恶，咒骂，诅咒，憎恶
items.en: to detest or curse

items.zh: 高傲的，傲慢的，目中无人的，看不起人的
items.en: behaving as though superior to others

items.zh: 声望，威望，威信，威名，名声
items.en: widespread respect and admiration

items.zh: 刺耳的，令人不适的，不协调的，不和谐的，使人烦恼的，（令人震惊地）不一致的
items.en: harsh or disturbing to the senses or nerves

items.zh: 感情夸张的，伤感的，夸张的，戏剧性的，戏剧化的
items.en: overly emotional or exaggerated

blocks.text: The editor would [[execrate]] a [[supercilious]] tone, seeing the [[prestige]] of the paper at stake; a [[jarring]] and [[melodramatic]] column lowered it.

items.zh: 告别词，告别演说，告别，惜别
items.en: a farewell speech or statement

items.zh: vi. 迅速成长扩大，蓬勃发展，萌芽，发芽，迅速增长；n. 嫩芽
items.en: to grow or flourish rapidly

items.zh: 加快进程，使加速，迅速完成，促进，派出
items.en: to make happen sooner or faster

items.zh: 两面派的，奸诈的，口是心非的，欺诈的
items.en: deceitful in speech or action

items.zh: 流行的，普遍的，盛行的，常见的，广泛存在的
items.en: widespread at a given time

blocks.text: His [[valediction]] let the trade [[burgeon]] and [[expedite]] new deals; the [[duplicitous]] agent saw the [[prevalent]] mood shift.

gloss.burgeon: 迅速成长扩大，蓬勃发展

items.zh: 无足轻重的，不重要的，琐碎的，微不足道的，（人）肤浅的
items.en: of little value or importance

items.zh: 断言，肯定地说出，宣称，声明，坚持，维护（权利、权威等）
items.en: to state with confidence

items.zh: 没有歧义的，清晰易懂的，透明的，显而易见的，易识破的，（体制等）公开透明的
items.en: easy to see through or understand

items.zh: 茫然的，愚蠢的，空虚的，空洞的，无意义的，（表情）呆滞的，空白的
items.en: empty; lacking thought or meaning

items.zh: 辅助性的，次要的，外围的，边缘的，不重要的，（神经）末梢的；n. 外围设备
items.en: on the edge; of minor importance

blocks.text: It is [[trivial]] to [[assert]] a [[transparent]] claim; the [[vacuous]] and [[peripheral]] point proved nothing.

gloss.transparent: 没有歧义的，清晰易懂的

questions.explain: certitude：确信无疑，确定，确实，确凿（complete certainty）。近义词：certainty, conviction。

options: 没有歧义的，清晰易懂的
挥霍的；过度的，不必要的
questions.explain: extravagant：挥霍的，奢侈的，过度的，不必要的，（言论、行为）过分的，浪费的（spending or doing more than is reasonable）。近义词：lavish, excessive。

questions.q: 哪个词的意思是「责难，抨击」？
questions.explain: impugn：责难，抨击，对…提出质疑，指责，非难（to challenge the truth or honesty of）。

questions.q: 哪个词和 **common** 的意思最接近？
questions.explain: prevalent 与 common 近义：widespread at a given time。

questions.q:
选最适合填入空格的词：

> The ____ of the new faith spoke with certitude; critics could discredit him, and the taciturn monk bore an animus against the court.
questions.explain: precursor：先驱者，先导，前身，前兆，预兆（something that comes before and leads to another）。
